::: portfolio-header

```{r}
#| echo: false
library(htmltools)

# One project card. Pass href = NULL for a project that is not public yet.
project_card <- function(title, description, skills, date, img, alt,
                         href = NULL, button = "View Project",
                         external = FALSE, status = NULL) {
  btn <- if (is.null(href)) {
    tags$span(status, class = "view-project-btn is-disabled")
  } else {
    tags$a(button, href = href, class = "view-project-btn",
           target = if (external) "_blank" else NULL,
           rel = if (external) "noopener" else NULL)
  }
  tags$div(
    class = "portfolio-card",
    tags$img(src = img, alt = alt, class = "card-image"),
    tags$div(
      class = "card-content",
      if (!is.null(status)) tags$p(status, class = "card-status"),
      tags$h3(title, class = "card-title"),
      tags$p(description, class = "card-description"),
      tags$p(skills, class = "card-tags"),
      if (!is.null(date)) tags$p(date, class = "card-date")
    ),
    btn
  )
}

card_row <- function(...) {
  tags$div(class = "card-row",
           list(...))
}
```

```{r}
tags$div(

      date = "2026",
      img = "images/caa_preview.jpg", alt = "Criação Animal Agroecológica homepage",
      href = "https://donadiojp.github.io/caa/", button = "Visit Website",
      external = TRUE
    ),
    project_card(
      title = "Water & Shade for Grazing Cattle",
      description = "How shade and water access affect the behaviour and thermal comfort of cows under Voisin Rational Grazing in a silvopastoral system.",
      skills = "R, Applied Ethology, Thermal Comfort, Silvopasture",
      date = NULL,
      img = "images/water_shade.jpg", alt = "Cows grazing under trees in a silvopastoral paddock",
      status = "Manuscript in preparation"
    )
  )
)
```
